part2.question: Describe a long trip that you often take but do not like

segments.v: I want to talk about the trip to my father's hometown in Nghệ An. We go there two or three times a year for family ceremonies. It is about 300 kilometres from Hà Nội. We always go by car. It takes about five hours, but on holidays it takes seven or eight hours because of the traffic. We have to go because my father is the oldest son and the ceremonies are very important in my family. I don't like the trip because it is very long and boring. I sit in the back seat with my sister and it is not comfortable. Sometimes I feel carsick. I also cannot study in the car. The rest stops are crowded and dirty. But I like meeting my cousins there.
